hero.subtitle: A training environment built for people who want to do more than just work out — they want to become better.

paragraphs: What if a gym could be more than a place you visit?
What if it could be a place where you actually learned how to train, surrounded yourself with the right people, and built something that lasted?
Today, our goal remains the same: to create a training environment where every person who walks through our doors has the opportunity to become stronger, healthier, and more confident.

pillars.title: Rethink How You Train.
pillars.description: Understand what you're doing and why you're doing it.

pillars.title: Rethink What Progress Means.
pillars.description: Progress isn't always about the number on the scale. It's about becoming stronger, fitter, and more capable.

pillars.title: Rethink What You're Capable Of.
pillars.description: Challenge the limits you've placed on yourself.

pillars.title: Rethink What A Gym Can Be.
pillars.description: A place to train, learn, connect, and become better.

finalCta.subtitle: Start training with purpose and discover a different way to approach fitness.
